comment: Auto body matching for the clip browser. packPattern is a case-insensitive regex tested against the relative path and the top-level pack folder. bodyNames are preferred mesh filenames (with or without .fbx). When no preset matches, Auto picks the mesh model in the same top-level pack folder with the best bone-name overlap. You can edit this file in a fork, or leave it as a starting point for Kevin Iglesias and PROTOFACTOR packs.
